synthetic_magnitude_stress.hypothesis: Cosine normalization discards positive arm magnitude when estimates remain collinear; a linear mean retains it.
synthetic_magnitude_stress.interpretation: deterministic assumption-violating construction, not a theorem counterexample or LLM benchmark

cost_sensitivity.hypothesis: Feasibility for estimated costs does not imply feasibility after selected realized costs increase.
cost_sensitivity.selection: all 1098 existing conditions; separately report main PILOT full-learning conditions
cost_sensitivity.intervention: multiply total recorded selected costs by factor, hold choices and rewards fixed
cost_sensitivity.interpretation: counterfactual cost accounting, not rerouted traffic or paid API calls

paper_comparison.comparison_rule: reported values versus local observations with explicit protocol differences; do not fabricate matched points or relative reproduction error
